instructions: Before updating an existing installation, call check_source_updates with its unchanged manifest and current local file hashes. Preserve pristine bundle contents in host Git for three-way diff/merge; hashes cannot reconstruct base contents. Only advance the manifest for changes actually applied and verified. Templates are host-owned compositions: review their changes selectively.
Write every returned file at its path in the host repository; the MCP server does not write host files.
Preserve existing host files unless the user authorizes an overwrite; compare src/components/ads/.ads-source.json integrity records before updating a previously installed bundle.
Install the returned dependencies with the host package manager and configure the existing build for StyleX source files under src/components/ads.
Load src/components/ads/styles.css once at the host application entrypoint and mount the returned ThemeProvider at the host-owned theme seam.
Import installed ADS code from the returned local entrypoints. Do not add @delightai/ads as a dependency.
Keep routing, data, authorization, persistence, analytics, and side effects in host-owned modules.
